assumptions.statement: The current use case is bounded indoor local-waypoint research, not an approved deployment mission.
The Genesis 13-link/27-shape envelope is historical simulated evidence, not a validated physical or ROS/Gazebo collision envelope.
Current maze objects are fixed ground, wall boxes, and landmark boxes without consequence-complete material, mass, fragility, person, safety-critical, or damage metadata.
The historical calf-link/Plane exclusion applies to the complete collapsed calf link and is not reinterpreted as foot-sphere-only support.
Perfect sensing supplies occurrence and attribution but not severity, acceptable consequence, recovery, stopping, ODD, or mission requirements.
Available reverse, yaw, hold, or curriculum behavior does not establish effective recovery, self-righting, stopping parity, or operator handoff.

unresolved_evidence.decision_affected: deployment contact scope and task-performance requirements
unresolved_evidence.needed: approved search or inspection application, ODD, human presence, asset classes, supervision, and mission consequences

unresolved_evidence.decision_affected: hard separation versus unresolved object context
unresolved_evidence.needed: object material, mass, mobility, fragility, safety criticality, person/proxy, permission, prohibition, and damage metadata
approved component/object force or validated substitute, impulse, speed, duration, repetition, penetration, stability, entrapment, and damage limits
Genesis, ROS/Gazebo, payload, and physical Go2 collision-envelope reconciliation
physical contact instrumentation and Genesis force/impulse calibration or a validated alternative
platform-equivalent stopping mode, request/acknowledgement latency, stopping distributions, and uncertainty margin
stuck/entrapment definition, successful separation and restored-capability criteria, recovery budget, repeat limit, and operator escalation
stakeholder-approved progress, coverage, revisit, inspection completeness, deadline, and missed-hazard consequence
formal hazard log, requirement ownership/allocation, acceptance criteria, verification independence, and SACE/AMLAS argument review

context_first_decision_order: unvalidated abnormal or unknown calf-link/ground contact remains unresolved
categorical or approved hard preaction separation
fail closed as severity or requirement unresolved

historical_h1.positive_scope: any frozen disallowed robot-environment contact at any physics step
preserved_exclusions: any of the four collapsed calf links paired with the simulator ground Plane

perfect_sensing_counterfactual.assumption: Every current and future full-body clearance/contact event is observed exactly, with zero latency and exact link, shape, object, time, and geometry attribution.
cannot_establish: material, human, property, fragile-asset, or safety-critical consequence
approved force, impulse, speed, duration, penetration, repetition, or damage limit
acceptable fall, stability, entrapment, or control-loss consequence
effective platform stopping or recovery response
approved operating domain and stakeholder risk tolerance
acceptable mission progress, coverage, completion, or missed-inspection consequence

preserved_predecessor_authority.exact_geometry_finding: Exact Genesis per-link geometry reconstructs immediate contact, successor contact, zero-versus-nonzero safe-action availability, and the complete two-ply viability decision.
preserved_predecessor_authority.range_finding: Under the current full-body, 13-link protected-contact scope, no tested one-, two-, three-, or diagnostic four-origin range arrangement reproduced that decision sufficiently.

criteria.criterion: every included hard-veto context has a stated hazard rationale
criteria.finding: person, fragile/critical/prohibited, damage, fall, stability, entrapment, and control-loss contexts are hazard-derived

criteria.criterion: every excluded hard-veto context has a defensible alternative treatment
criteria.finding: fixed-wall, landmark, abnormal-ground, and region-specific physical consequences lack approved limits and recovery authority
only valid self-contact and explicitly complete ordinary calf/ground support context are prospectively permitted; H1 custody remains link-level
no incomplete contact is relabelled harmless or recoverable

criteria.criterion: operational safety and task performance are represented separately
criteria.finding: physical-contact category and monitor/recovery/task overlays are separate

criteria.criterion: simulated proxy and deployment claim are distinguished
criteria.finding: H1 remains a rigid-simulation separation proxy only

criteria.criterion: scope is not derived from sensor outcomes
criteria.finding: requirements objective outcome field set is empty and perfect-sensing counterfactual is unchanged

criteria.criterion: decision is deterministic and machine readable
criteria.finding: context-first rules, exhaustive matrix, canonical receipts, and validators are frozen

criteria.criterion: all assumptions and evidence gaps are recorded
criteria.finding: assumption inventory and Stage-B blocker ledger are complete for the reviewed sources

blockers: approved application and operational design domain
stakeholder-reviewed harm and mission non-performance consequences
object material, mass, mobility, fragility, person, safety-critical, and damage metadata
approved component/object severity, stability, entrapment, and damage limits
validated physical instrumentation or permanent simulated-proxy restriction
platform-equivalent stop request, acknowledgement, response time, and stopping envelope
successful separation, restored capability, recovery budget, repetition, and handoff requirements
system allocation, acceptance criteria, traceability, and independent verification plan
prohibitions: remove a protected link, shape, body region, direction, or swept volume
reinterpret or change a completed contact label
select a narrower scope using sensor, model, calibration, or evaluation performance
collect a new panel or train a model under a narrowed scope

hazard_rows.assumption: person consequence requires separation unless an approved hazard process states otherwise
hazard_rows.evidence: contact hazard analysis and prospective person object field
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no person model, injury criterion, detector, or approved separation distance

hazard_rows.assumption: object class and prohibition are available before action
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no fragility, criticality, material, damage, or permission metadata

hazard_rows.assumption: simulated geometry is evidence rather than a physical payload envelope
hazard_rows.evidence: Genesis component inventory and platform manifest
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no payload load case, damage limit, impact calibration, or collision-envelope parity

hazard_rows.assumption: joint obstruction is plausible but not established by link identity
hazard_rows.evidence: URDF function and stuck-or-entrapment ontology annotation
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no entrapment definition, saturation consequence, dynamic object, or recovery envelope

hazard_rows.assumption: primitive and phase can distinguish intended support from abnormal contact
hazard_rows.evidence: historical calf-link Plane exclusion and component inventory
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: link-level H1 exclusion supplies no support phase, severity, or entanglement criterion

hazard_rows.assumption: stability consequence can be prospectively detected and bounded
hazard_rows.evidence: contact ontology stability and fall fields
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no approved fall limit, physical calibration, or minimum-risk response

hazard_rows.assumption: a repetition budget and effective response can be specified
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no approved repeat, recovery-cycle, or escalation limit

hazard_rows.assumption: stuck is a useful monitor signal
hazard_rows.evidence: stuck detector and prospective contact ontology
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: stuck does not identify entrapment, controller failure, deliberate hold, or recoverability

hazard_rows.assumption: the application can define minimum meaningful progress
hazard_rows.evidence: progression non-performance text and local-waypoint specification
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no approved progress, deadline, intervention, or mission-loss criterion

hazard_rows.assumption: abstention is observable and a bounded fallback can be implemented
hazard_rows.evidence: progression document and factorised planner design
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no approved abstention count, operator handoff, or mission consequence

hazard_rows.assumption: deployment stakeholders can define inspection sufficiency
hazard_rows.hazard: failure to complete inspection or search
hazard_rows.residual_limitation: no approved coverage, revisit, deadline, or missed-hazard consequence
